decisions.decision: Claude builds everything that doesn't need the vendors, now. (1) Change the why text on card d1-list-partner (workshop-cards.ts:698) from 'cleans and verifies it like any CSV' to 'cleans it (dedupes, fixes names and domains, drops bad rows)'. Make no verification promise anywhere on the card. (2) In the cloud/src list-clean job, add a header-alias mapper that accepts the common vendor column names (First Name/first_name, Company/Organization, Email/Work Email, LinkedIn URL, Title, Website/Domain). Add a probe fixture with 5 dummy rows. Swap in the real column names when Sohan or Ashiqe's sample arrives. (3) Build the default hand-off: the existing List Partner Leads tab, plus an optional one-email-per-order sender that stays off until the vendors give an address (config in ~/.config/tantra/data-vendors.json). Run the probes, then deploy. Nelbin still contacts Sohan and Ashiqe for the sample CSV, order method and turnaround, and records them here.
decisions.why: T-301 spec items 3 and 4 and the column mapper can all be built now. Line 698 still says 'verifies', which breaks the no-paid-verification rule (google-and-reminder-model, 2026-10-07). Only the vendors' replies are outside input, and Nelbin owns that contact, not Adi.
